D5.status: UNTESTED (emptiness of the admitted region inside the computational box is not proven by one engine run)
D5.deciding_test: Restart rule, declared before any run: a second engine run on the same coordinate boxes, numerics block and driver with rng_seed 1 and global_design_count 24 (a coordinate spec V002 that changes only engine_parameters; the theta cache id excludes engine parameters, so every earlier point replays at zero cost and only new points are launched).
D5.tested_negative_condition: TESTED-NEGATIVE (no admitted point in the box at that design resolution) only if BOTH runs end NO_ADMITTED_POINT_FOUND AND every evaluation of both runs is VALID or MODEL_INVALID by the taxonomy (no NUMERICS_LIMITED or INFRA halt resolved as invalid by root). Otherwise the outcome stays UNTESTED.
